$comment: Sentry's dedicated Claude Code automation settings.
Passed with --settings so the interactive installation's configuration is
NOT inherited. Prompt-skipping and permission-bypass flags must never appear
in this file: a Sentry-dispatched run is unattended, so there is nobody to
answer a permission prompt and nothing may be auto-approved on their behalf.
A test asserts those flag names are absent from this file entirely, which is
why they are described here rather than named.
Tools are additionally allowlisted per work-order mode on the command line;
this file is the floor, not the whole policy.
